# PerkStack Documentation

> Complete documentation for PerkStack, the loyalty points and product reviews platform for Shopify merchants. These docs cover setup, loyalty programs, reviews, storefront widgets, integrations, billing, and troubleshooting.

## Getting Started

- [Getting Started](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/getting-started/introduction): Install PerkStack, complete first time setup, and learn the core concepts.
- [Welcome](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/welcome): Orientation and overview of what PerkStack does.
- [Dashboard](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/dashboard): The PerkStack admin home and how to read it.

## Loyalty

- [Loyalty](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/loyalty/points-system): Points programs, earn rules, rewards, tiers, and birthday rewards.

## Reviews

- [Reviews](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/reviews): Collecting, moderating, and displaying product reviews.

## Storefront and Customization

- [Widgets](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/widgets/loyalty-launcher): Storefront widgets including the loyalty launcher, checkout widget, and review stars.
- [Customizing](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customizing): Theme and appearance options for storefront elements.

## Customers and Analytics

- [Customers](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/customers): Managing customer loyalty profiles and activity.
- [Analytics](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/analytics): Reporting on loyalty and review performance.

## Settings and Integrations

- [Settings](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/settings): App configuration and program settings.
- [Integrations](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/integrations): Connecting PerkStack with other tools and platforms.
- [Advanced](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/advanced): Advanced configuration for power users.

## Operations and Billing

- [Operations](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/operations): Day to day running of your program.
- [Billing](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/billing): Plans, pricing, and subscription management.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.perk-stack.com/docs/troubleshooting/faq): Common issues and frequently asked questions.

## More

- [PerkStack Website](https://perk-stack.com): Product site and Shopify app listing.
- [PerkStack Blog](https://blog.perk-stack.com): Guides, updates, and merchant tips.
